Here, $A$ is a $1\times 2$ matrix and $B$ is a $2\times 3$ matrix. 

There are $2$ columns in $A$ and $2$ rows in $B,$ so $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{A}_{1\times \boxed{\text{2}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{2}}\times 3}={AB}_{1\times 3}
$$

Let's compute $AB,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \begin{bmatrix}2 & 3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 & -2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & -3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}9 & ∗ & ∗\end{bmatrix}, &  & \,9=2\cdot 3+3\cdot 1 \\  & \begin{bmatrix}2 & 3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 & -2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & -3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}9 & 2 & ∗\end{bmatrix}, &  & \,2=2\cdot (-2)+3\cdot 2 \\  & \begin{bmatrix}2 & 3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 & -2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & -3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}9 & 2 & -7\end{bmatrix}, &  & \,-7=2\cdot 1+3\cdot (-3)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$$
\displaystyle AB=\begin{bmatrix}9 & 2 & -7\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Here, $E$ is a $2\times 4$ matrix and $F$ is a $4\times 2$ matrix. 

There are $4$ columns in $E$ and $4$ rows in $F,$ so $E$ and $F$ are conformable for multiplication:

$$
{E}_{2\times \boxed{\text{4}}}{\cdot }_{✓}{F}_{\boxed{\text{4}}\times 2}={EF}_{2\times 2}
$$

Let's compute $EF,$ one element at a time:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 1 & 1 \\ -2 & 3 & 0 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 \\ -4 & 2 \\ -3 & -1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-10 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗\end{bmatrix}, \\ & \,-10=(-1)\cdot 3+(-2)\cdot 0+1\cdot (-4)+1\cdot (-3) \\  & \begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 1 & 1 \\ -2 & 3 & 0 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 \\ -4 & 2 \\ -3 & -1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-10 & -4 \\ ∗ & ∗\end{bmatrix}, \\ & \,-4=(-1)\cdot 3+(-2)\cdot 1+1\cdot 2+1\cdot (-1) \\  & \begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 1 & 1 \\ -2 & 3 & 0 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 \\ -4 & 2 \\ -3 & -1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-10 & -4 \\ -3 & ∗\end{bmatrix}, \\ & \,-3=(-2)\cdot 3+3\cdot 0+0\cdot (-4)+(-1)\cdot (-3) \\  & \begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 1 & 1 \\ -2 & 3 & 0 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 \\ -4 & 2 \\ -3 & -1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-10 & -4 \\ -3 & -2\end{bmatrix}, \\ & \,-2=(-2)\cdot 3+3\cdot 1+0\cdot 2+(-1)\cdot (-1)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$$
\displaystyle EF=\begin{bmatrix}-10 & -4 \\ -3 & -2\end{bmatrix}.
$$
